question:
Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

Good characteristics are indispensible to succeed in life
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indispensable"** means something that is absolutely necessary or essential. (अनिवार्य)
 
 
• **Example:** Good health is indispensable for a happy life.
 
 
 
• The word **"Indispensible"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Indispensable"**. (अनिवार्य)
 
 
• **Example:** Good leadership is indispensable for the success of any organization.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Indespensable** (अनिवार्य): This is an incorrect spelling of "Indispensable".
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Indespensible** (अनिवार्य): This is an incorrect spelling of "Indispensable".
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Indispenscibe** (अनिवार्य): This is an incorrect spelling of "Indispensable".
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 

a7:Ta3f,
